d: Military science fiction frontline worlds and alien battlegrounds in Marko Kloos’s Frontlines series.

hip-113368.x: Major human agricultural colony world orbiting Fomalhaut, devastatingly assaulted and terraformed by invading Lankies.

luhman-16.x: Brown dwarf binary system occupied by a massive Lanky seeding fleet, threatening the immediate Solar neighborhood.

hip-32349.x: Human frontier colony world orbiting Sirius, a critical strategic bulwark against extraterrestrial incursions.

hip-24608.x: Heavily fortified human military and industrial system at Capella providing fleet support during the Lanky campaign.

mars.x: Primary naval garrison and orbital construction shipyards of the North American Commonwealth Armed Forces.

b.s: Interstellar war zones fought between humanity (NAC and SRA) and the titanic extraterrestrial Lankies across nearby real-sky star systems including Fomalhaut, Capella, Sirius, and Luhman 16.
